document_strings: may 2003 prove to be the year you are most HAPPY
I HAVE been very busy reminiscing since Ghislaine asked me to write about you for your book.
I keep thinking about then and now.
My father drove Seymour and me to the hospital that cold, snowy day in January to become parents of a beautiful, healthy son, Jeff.
You have been a good son from day one and we have been proud of you ever since.
